49.original: I'll get right to the point, <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303>. The higher-ups have authorized plans to form a specialized squad and we're on the lookout for a reliable leader. Your name was at the top of the list.

50.original: You would be responsible for training and commanding a number of adventurer subordinates, and the position also comes with the possibility of further promotion. What say you, <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303>? Are you ready to lead?

56.original: Ah. Well, that's not the response I was hoping for, but it's best we're all honest here. A hesitant commander is a danger to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> own troops.

57.original: Outstanding! Let's get you acquainted with your second-in-command right away.

59.original: And these eager troopers are the inaugural members of our squadron. Form up!

60.original: Every one of them is a fledgling adventurer who enlisted in the hopes of following in your legendary footsteps. They're green to the military, aye, but we'll harden them up soon enough.

61.original: When you've a moment to spare, stop by the barracks and we can discuss their training and deployment in greater detail.

62.original: I'll leave you to it, then, Commander.

63.original: What do you think? I'll admit they're raw as soldiers go, but they certainly have potential. I look forward to seeing what you can do with them.

64.original: Right, I won't keep you any longer. Your squad's barracks can be found through the door at the back of the <hex:020815E1E93501FF0D636F6D6D616E6420726F6F6DFF0103><hex:020815E1E93601FF0D41646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:020817E1E93701FF0F48616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103>.

66.original: You are now the commander of an adventurer squadron!<hex:02100103>Enter the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020813E1E93601FF0B5477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:02080EE1E93701FF06466C616D65FF0103> Barracks and speak with your squadron sergeant to issue deployment orders.
